en: Fixed the API retry notice sitting at "Retrying in 0s" during the next attempt, now "retrying…", and the "will retry in" countdown freezing when a reply stalled or with Reduce motion on
zh: 修复 API 重试提示在下一次尝试期间停留在“Retrying in 0s”（现为“retrying…”）的问题，以及回复停滞或开启 Reduce motion 时“will retry in”倒计时冻结的问题
